CHOICE-001.C1: What did you see on deck three, {{@a1}}?
CHOICE-001.C2: I am not going any further.

reactor_breach.DIALOG-001: No sound. Of course there is no sound.
reactor_breach.DIALOG-002: Reactor deck.{|} The floor is warm through my boots.
reactor_breach.DIALOG-003: Someone has been down here. Recently.
reactor_breach.DIALOG-005: Then tell me what I am looking at.
reactor_breach.DIALOG-007: Do not say my name out loud.
reactor_breach.DIALOG-008: Everyone done? The {{i2}} is still on the panel.
reactor_breach.DIALOG-009: We are going back up. Now.
reactor_breach.DIALOG-010: {:a2}That is enough for one shift. Seal {{#ui.hud.airlock_label}}.
reactor_breach.DIALOG-011: Do not touch the coupling, {{@a2}}. I mean it.
reactor_breach.DIALOG-012: Good morning. Today is the fourteenth of a month I no longer hold.
